description: JEV System One tool-guard POC for AegisCMCP agent control loops

modes.off: Guard disabled; all tools execute as before
modes.stub: Offline deterministic heuristics (no API key); good for local demos/tests
modes.live: Call JEV HTTP API with JEV_API_KEY / TYPESAFE_API_KEY

env.JEV_TOOL_GUARD_ENABLED: true enables live when JEV_MODE unset

notes: JEV returns signals; application policy still owns allow/deny enforcement.
Read-only tools (kb_search, kb_get_document, health/stats) are not guarded.
POC treats confirm and review as blocks so agents cannot self-approve.
